        c.commregistry,

        c.langpattern,
        c.msgtally,

        c.susppatscore,

        CASE c.vpnflag
            WHEN 'Yes' THEN 1
            WHEN 'Suspected' THEN 0.5
            WHEN 'No' THEN 0
            ELSE 0
        END AS vpnflag_numeric,
        -- Language pattern numeric mapping
        CASE c.langpattern
            WHEN 'Consistent' THEN 1
            WHEN 'Variable' THEN 2
            WHEN 'Suspicious' THEN 3
            ELSE 1
        END AS langpattern_numeric
    FROM communication c
),
risk_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        *,
        -- CSR calculation
        (iptally * 5) + (tornodecount * 2) + (vpnflag_numeric * 30) + (brwsrunique / 10.0) + (susppatscore * 3) + (riskindiccount * 4) AS csr,

    FROM comm_data
)

    CASE 
        WHEN cpr > 70 AND langpattern = 'Suspicious' AND csr > 80 THEN 'Deceptive Pattern'
        ELSE 'Normal Pattern'
    END AS pattern_type
FROM risk_scores
ORDER BY csr DESC;
